title: tfgen.yml v1.1
description: What a config folder's YAML DSLs compile to: the globals, the templates a stack takes, and a generator per DSL.

version.description: Config format version: `1.0` or `1.1`, or `1` for the newest 1.x tfgen knows.

descriptors.description: File names a stack's descriptor may have.

globals.description: Values every stack reads as `tfgen.<name>`, with refs; a key `<name> fn.format*` computes one.

generators.description: A generator per DSL, by the DSL's `id` in `yaml-dsl.yml`.

templates.description: Templates a stack takes by name, in its `tfgen.templates`.

performance.description: How a run uses the machine.

schema_cache_capacity.description: Schema URL copies kept; the least recently used is dropped first.

written_to.description: The generated file, in the stack's directory.

schema.description: Where a document's schema is when its modeline names none on disk: paths, path patterns and URLs, with refs, the first found taken.

builtin_values.description: The value each builtin of the DSL's scopes takes for a stack, with refs.

data_files.description: JSONPaths of fields whose values name files the stack reads.

values.description: Values computed once per stack, read as `values.<name>`.

blocks.description: Templates written for the parts of the folded document each selects, in the document's order.

references.description: How a reference of the DSL is written, the first rule matching taken.

value.description: The value, with refs; with `each`, the value of each part selected.

default.description: The value where `value` reads an absent key. Not with `each`.

each.description: A JSONPath into the folded document; the value is a list, one item per part selected.

where.description: Fields a selected part must hold, each equal to its value. With `each`.

defaults.description: Fields a selected part takes where it holds none. With `each`.

template.description: The template file, relative to the config folder.

each.description: What the template is written once for, read as `each`. Absent, it is written once per stack.

scope.description: The scope whose declarations are selected. With `each: declaration` or `each: scope_key`.

path.description: A JSONPath into the folded document. With `each: entry`.

scope_keys.description: Only the declarations under these scope keys.

scope_keys_except.description: Every declaration except those under these scope keys.

value_matches.description: A regular expression the selected value's text, or a reference as written, must match.

scope.description: The scope of the references the rule writes.

scope_keys.description: Only references under these scope keys.

path_matches.description: A regular expression the reference's path after its name must match.

template.description: The HCL expression written for the reference, reading `reference.scope_key`, `reference.name` and `reference.path`.

file.description: The template file, relative to the config folder.

written_to.description: The generated file, in the stack's directory.

required_providers.description: The providers the template requires, each by its source, written into `stack.__required_providers__`.

call.description: A function call whose result is the value, such as `fn.format*: [layout, operands...]`.
